We are a leading provider in ecommerce recurring billing, and our middleware powers over 200,000 terminals and processes over two billion transactions annually. Our applications support over 800 integrations into POS solutions. We have built our reputation through seamless integration of payment terminals and POS systems and are continuing to innovate in creating a terminal and acquirer independent payment solicitor for in-store. Our clients include major banks and retailers such as Woolworths, David Jones, JB Hi-Fi, and Bunnings. Our goal is to continuously lead the payments industry with new technology delivering value to clients, which who include merchants, banks, acquirers and POS vendors, expanding our presence into other regions. About The Role As an L2 Support Technician, you'll be the friendly, capable voice on the other end of the line when our clients need help with their payment solutions. You'll build genuine relationships with the businesses we support, solve real problems that keep tills ringing, and become a go-to expert on how payments work behind the scenes. Great communication, sharp problem-solving and a genuine curiosity about payment systems are the name of the game. Day shift: Monday – Friday 9:00am to 5:00pm (Hybrid, up to 3 days in office) Key Responsibilities Providing technical support for Linkly's payment solutions and applications via phone and email. Installing and managing Linkly's software. Troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues within payment environments, supporting our partners and users directly. Spotting patterns and trends in incoming support requests (you'll be our early warning system). Documenting solutions, known errors and fixes in our internal knowledge base so the whole team gets smarter. Keeping stakeholders in the loop with timely, clear communication. Teaming up with internal crews to squash technical issues and roll out new solutions. This Could Be You If You want to take your support experience deeper into fintech, one of the fastest growing spaces around. You get a kick out of helping businesses fix the IT problems standing between them and taking payments. You're patient, customer-focused and happy to guide people through the tricky stuff. You're curious, analytical and technical enough to dig into the more complex puzzles. You're comfortable and confident providing support over phone and email. You're keen to help clients through testing and implementation of new products. Our Perfect Match 2+ years of experience in a technical customer support role. Technically literate (an IT degree, Diploma or similar is a nice to have, not a must). Hungry to build the skills and knowledge that will take your career places. Able to follow clear privacy and security requirements (we handle payments, so this one's non-negotiable!). Our Values Act Like an Owner: Take full accountability for outcomes and make decisions with the long-term success of Linkly in mind. Innovate: Challenge assumptions, champion new ideas and drive meaningful change for customers and the business. Deepen Trust: Build confidence through integrity, transparency and consistent delivery with your team, partners and clients. Care and Respect: Foster an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work.

review_candidates.title: Customer Support Engineer – Teamcenter (Remote/Hybrid)
review_candidates.location: São Caetano do Sul, São Paulo, Brazil
review_candidates.description: About The Role As part of the Teamcenter support team, you will work closely with customers and internal technical teams to investigate Teamcenter product questions and issues, coordinate resolution activities, and help deliver a high-quality customer experience. This role combines customer engagement with technical problem-solving and provides the opportunity to build deep knowledge of Teamcenter, including its functionality, architecture, PLM processes, and customer environments through hands-on investigation, structured learning, and collaboration with experienced Teamcenter specialists and technical teams. What You'll Do Work directly with customers on Teamcenter questions and issues, developing an understanding of their PLM processes, product usage, and technical environment. Perform initial technical investigation of Teamcenter customer-reported issues, gathering and analyzing relevant functional and technical information to better understand the problem and support an effective resolution. Collaborate with Teamcenter Support, Product Development, Cloud Operations, and other technical teams to investigate issues, share relevant findings, and help drive customer problems toward resolution. Maintain ownership of Teamcenter customer issues, coordinating with multiple stakeholders and ensuring clear communication and progress throughout the resolution process. Communicate technical and functional findings, next steps, and resolution progress clearly to customers and internal stakeholders with different levels of Teamcenter and technical expertise. Document Teamcenter investigations, findings, workarounds, and resolutions clearly and accurately, contributing to effective knowledge sharing and future problem resolution. Continuously develop deeper Teamcenter product and technical knowledge through hands-on experience, structured learning, investigation of real customer scenarios, and collaboration with experienced Teamcenter specialists. Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Previous experience in technical support, application/software support, or hands-on experience with Teamcenter in a key user, functional, implementation, administration, or similar role. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply a structured approach to troubleshooting complex software and Teamcenter-related issues. Solid technical foundation in enterprise software environments, with familiarity in areas relevant to Teamcenter environments such as operating systems, databases, networking, application architecture, or cloud technologies. Hands-on experience investigating technical issues using diagnostic information such as application logs, system behavior, monitoring data, or other relevant technical evidence. Ability to reproduce, isolate, and systematically analyze technical problems to identify potential causes and support effective resolution. Strong customer-facing communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical and functional findings, next steps, and resolution progress to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to drive Teamcenter customer issues forward, coordinate with multiple stakeholders, and maintain focus through resolution. Ability to document technical and functional investigations, findings, workarounds, and resolutions clearly and accurately, contributing to effective Teamcenter knowledge sharing and future problem resolution. Demonstrated ability and motivation to learn complex enterprise software products and continuously develop deeper Teamcenter product and technical knowledge. Curiosity and a proactive learning mindset, with the ability to independently explore unfamiliar Teamcenter and technical topics and apply new knowledge to real customer problems. Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and technical teams in both written and verbal interactions. Preferred / Nice To Have Hands-on experience with Teamcenter is highly desirable, particularly in support, key user, functional, implementation, administration, or similar roles. Practical knowledge of PLM concepts, processes, and workflows, either with Teamcenter or other enterprise PLM solutions, is highly desirable. Experience troubleshooting or supporting enterprise applications with architectural or technology characteristics relevant to complex PLM environments is a plus. Exposure to scripting, programming, or automation technologies is a plus. Experience supporting or working with enterprise applications in cloud or SaaS environments is a plus. Experience working in global or cross-functional environments, collaborating with customers, support, engineering, product, and other technical teams, is a plus. Training and Development We recognize that Teamcenter is a complex enterprise platform with a broad technology stack. New team members receive an onboarding and training period that includes product training, technical knowledge transfer, shadowing experienced engineers, and exposure to real customer cases. During onboarding, you will have access to experienced team members who can provide guidance and help you build product knowledge. Because this is an Advanced-level position, we expect you to build on your existing technical support experience, pick up new concepts quickly, become comfortable making technical decisions, and progress toward independently handling your workload and customer cases. Strong problem-solving skills are essential, including the ability to investigate complex issues, ask the right questions, research unfamiliar technologies, collaborate effectively with technical experts, and determine appropriate next steps toward resolution. The position is based around Pacific (and/or Asia Pacific) Time Zone business hours, with some flexibility in the daily schedule. As part of a global organization, there may occasionally be opportunities to adjust your schedule slightly to collaborate with colleagues or attend meetings across different time zones. What Success Looks Like As you complete onboarding and develop your Teamcenter knowledge, you will become increasingly comfortable managing customer cases independently. You will be able to assess an issue, collect the appropriate technical information, perform an initial investigation, and determine reasonable next troubleshooting steps. For more complex issues, you will know when and how to collaborate with experienced engineers, Engineering, or other technical teams. You will have daily support, collaboration, and technical resources from your immediate team, as well as access to our global Support organization and subject matter experts across different regions and time zones. Our collaborative environment provides opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues, exchange knowledge, and work together on complex technical challenges. Successful engineers in this role are curious, proactive, organized, accountable, and comfortable learning continuously. They take responsibility for moving their cases forward while recognizing that complex problems are often solved through teamwork. Why us? Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday # LI- REMOTE

Hands-on experience with modern RecSys paradigms, including: Graph-based Recommenders for modeling user–item–context relationships. Ability to bridge RecSys with LLM/Agent systems - LLM-augmented recommendation, conversational recommenders, agentic personalization workflows, and embedding-based retrieval at scale. Hands-on experience with Docker and comfortable working in Linux environments. Proficiency in Python (primary) and familiarity with TypeScript (secondary). Mastery of modern agent frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, AutoGen, or OpenAI Agents SDK. Deep experience implementing agentic workflows, multi-agent collaboration architectures, and advanced prompting techniques. Hands-on experience with Vector Databases and hybrid search strategies for RAG implementation. Solid understanding of Deep Learning concepts, specifically Transformer architectures and attention mechanisms. Experience with observability and evaluation tools (e.g., LangSmith, Arize) to trace, debug, and run experiments on agent performance. Practical experience with LLM fine-tuning is a strong bonus. Ability to manage context effectively, implementing short-term and long-term memory strategies for agents. Experience in asynchronous systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis PubSub) or real-time communication (WebSocket, gRPC) is preferred. Experience in building specific AI Voice Assistants/Call Centers, or implementing advanced strategies for hallucination reduction and LLM caching is preferred. Engineer advanced RAG systems with complex context window management and long-term memory persistence strategies. Optimize production performance, focusing on latency, cost efficiency, and throughput of LLM calls. Architect and build scalable, stateful multi-agent systems where specialized agents collaborate to solve complex enterprise problems.
